name: Keyboard Improved
description:
This tweak makes the stock XT9 keyboard ultra-responsive. With the Dictation app installed and switched on, * starts voice dictation in text fields.

| Key press to suggestions | Stock | Improved |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Letters, median | 172 ms | 18 ms |
| Letters, p95 | 212 ms | 26 ms |
| Letters, p99 | not measured | 45 ms |
| Letters, slowest | 247 ms | 76 ms |
| Space, median | 96 ms | 20 ms |
| Other keys, p95 | 131 ms | 26 ms |
author: thooton
